_note: Riddles: level is easy or medium; answer is the position of the right option, starting at 0. Degree: programme names should match the knowledge base.

riddles.q: What has hands but cannot clap?
riddles.why: A clock has hands that point to the time.

riddles.q: What has to be broken before you can use it?
I'm tall when I'm young and short when I'm old. What am I?
riddles.why: A candle gets shorter as it burns.

riddles.q: What has many keys but can't open a single door?
What comes next: 2, 4, 6, 8, ...?
What gets wetter the more it dries?
Which one is the odd one out?
riddles.why: A carrot is a vegetable; the others are fruits.

riddles.q: What has a face and two hands but no arms or legs?
What has one eye but cannot see?
How many legs do two cats and one bird have altogether?
riddles.why: Two cats have 8 legs and one bird has 2.

riddles.q: What goes up but never comes down?
Which shape has three sides?
What comes next: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ...?
riddles.why: Each number is the sum of the two before it.

riddles.q: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. What am I?
A farmer has 17 sheep and all but 9 run away. How many are left?
What is 1010 in binary as an ordinary number?
The more you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?
If two robots build two toys in two minutes, how long does one robot take to build one toy?
riddles.why: Each robot builds one toy in two minutes.

riddles.q: Which number is missing: 3, 9, 27, ?, 243
What can travel around the world while staying in a corner?
What has cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and water but no fish?
A bat and a ball cost 110 rupees. The bat costs 100 rupees more than the ball. How much is the ball?
Which word is spelled the same forwards and backwards?
You see a boat full of people, yet there isn't a single person on board. How?
